name: Mune Kyun! Yunikko Mahjong
original_name: 萌キュン！ゆにっ娘ま～じゃん
source:
Main character decides to participate in mahjong competition to help Chiyori. According to the rules, the winning side can do anything to the opponent. Can protagonist win in the competition?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角决定参加麻将比赛，帮助千织。按照规则，胜者可以对败者为所欲为。主角能赢得比赛吗？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
